# icrabuilders.com

> icrabuilders.com is a premium .com domain name available for acquisition at $14,997 USD.
> It is the exact-match, natural-language brand for ICRA (Infection Control Risk Assessment)
> builders serving healthcare construction, hospital renovation, and infection control compliance.

## What the site is

A single-page domain acquisition landing page. It explains the market opportunity for ICRA
expertise in healthcare construction, what the icrabuilders.com brand represents, why the
name is strategically valuable, and answers buyer questions about price, escrow, and transfer.

## Key facts

- Domain: icrabuilders.com
- Status: available for sale, clean title, ready for immediate transfer
- Asking price: $14,997 USD (serious offers considered)
- Transfer: professional escrow (Escrow.com), typically 1-5 business days
- Contact: sales@desertrich.com

## Primary audience

Healthcare-focused general contractors, specialty medical renovation firms, ICRA training and
certification providers, healthtech and compliance software companies, consulting practices,
and strategic domain investors.

## Pages

- [Home](https://icrabuilders.com/): domain offering, market opportunity, brand value, FAQ, inquiry form
